issues.message: ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications.

activity.body:
Cause: `CartDrawer` maps `cart.items` before the refetch settles. The cart endpoint returns `items: undefined` for an emptied basket, not `[]` (`api/cart.ts:88`).

Fix: default to `[]` in the endpoint and guard the drawer. On Priya's gift-wrap branch as `a41c9e2`. Resolve in the next release once it merges.

Happens when the basket is emptied from another tab while the drawer is open. `items` comes back `undefined` from the cart endpoint instead of `[]`.

Fix is in progress — see the gift-wrap branch.
